records.text: Dan Merrell said roughly ten inches of soil had been removed around the hole before he arrived.
records.speaker: Dan Merrell

appearances.snippet: When I showed up, I took pictures of what it looked like. They had taken out about 10 inches of the dirt around the hole.

verification.notes: Dan Merrell stated in a recorded interview that he arrived after excavation and observed about ten inches of dirt removed. This verifies that he made the first-person observation, though no independent measurement is public.
